title: Jim Semivan's 7-hour briefing at the CIA

tellings.quote: the 7-hour briefing. They tell him, these high level guys tell him, "Get a room in the CIA for 6 to8 hours.

plain: A man named Jim Semivan was told by very senior officials to book a room at CIA headquarters for six to eight hours, because the briefing they had for him would take that long. The researcher Grant Cameron tells Michels this as something Semivan told him, and calls it "the 7-hour briefing"; if true, the matter behind it was big enough to fill most of a working day inside the CIA.
